user.title: Choose area
user.description: Which area should have automatic covers?

room.title: Covers in {area}
room.description: Choose the covers and sensors of the room. Entities from the area are suggested.

data_description.presence_entity: When someone is present, covers open during the day.
data_description.sleep_entity: Switch that indicates sleep mode. Without it there are no sleep settings.
data_description.climate_entity: Heating or cooling decides whether sun is let in or blocked while nobody is home.

data_description.window_entity: While the window is open, the cover opens at least to the window position.
data_description.orientation: Compass direction the window faces, or an azimuth in degrees.
data_description.shading_position: Leave empty to use the room setting.
data_description.shading_conditions: Optional. All conditions must be met to shade.

outdoor.title: Outdoor sensors
outdoor.description: These apply to the whole house and are suggested for the next room.

data.presence_label: Label of the house presence sensors

data_description.dusk_entity: Without it, sunset counts as dusk.
data_description.presence_label: If none of these sensors is on, the house counts as empty.
